method: patchwise NCC on open ground (pit-free CHM < 0.5 m on >= 85% of a 50 m patch, the rest masked; patches on a 100 m lattice), +-4 m search in 0.25 m steps, parabolic refinement. Reference either the laser near-ground intensity (HAG < 0.3 m, 0.5 m cells, gap-filled) or another orthophoto band; shift = moving position minus reference position. Accepted: peak r >= 0.35, >= 0.15 above the patch median, not on the search border. Both images high-passed: each minus a Gaussian of sigma 6 m (the laser on its 0.5 m lattice, each photo band on its 0.32 m mosaic, no-data pixels left out), and no structure test (the acceptance rule above stands).

rule: direct laser pair with >= 30 accepted patches, else chained through the photo-photo pair with most accepted patches; applied only when >= 0.25 m; a direct laser pair below 30 patches counts only where the owner accepted that pair at that count (registration.ownerAccepted)
